item.title: Taylor Swift’s ‘August,’ ‘Father Figure’ & Other Songs Removed From Trump-Related TikTok Posts
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our show, where we dive into the latest news and trends. Today, we're talking about a dramatic turn of events on TikTok, involving none other than Taylor Swift and the Team Trump account.
[Soft music continues in the background]
Host: So, what happened? Well, earlier this week, the Team Trump account shared a video of Donald and Melania Trump watching a fireworks show, set to Taylor Swift's song "August" from her 2020 album Folklore. The caption even gave a shoutout to Taylor, saying they were sure she'd be excited they used her song.
[Short pause]
Host: But, it seems Taylor wasn't thrilled about it. Fast forward to Friday, and the song "August" was removed from the video. A message on the video now reads, "This sound isn't available." TikTok users were quick to react, with comments like "TAYLOR REMOVING THE AUDIO QUEEEEEEN" and "She removed it, clocked you guys."
[Soft music continues]
Host: This isn't the first time a Taylor Swift song has disappeared from a Team Trump post. Apparently, another clip featuring her song "Father Figure" is no longer available, and a video on the White House's official TikTok account featuring her song "The Fate of Ophelia" has also vanished.
[Short pause]
Host: The Team Trump account didn't take the removal of the song lightly, though. They responded by using a live performance version of Taylor's song "Red" and creating a mock-up of the album cover with Trump's profile on it. The caption even joked that Taylor wrote a whole album about the color of the Republican Party.
[Soft music continues]
Host: It's worth noting that Taylor Swift and Donald Trump have had a complicated history, with Trump being critical of the singer since 2018. Tensions escalated after Taylor endorsed Kamala Harris in the 2024 presidential election.
[Outro music starts playing]
Host: That's all for today's show. Thanks for tuning in to our discussion on the latest drama between Taylor Swift and the Team Trump account on TikTok. We'll be back with more news and trends soon.
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
